content: As of July 2026, the mining GET market landscape is characterized by a profound shift toward greater hardware interoperability, operational efficiency, and overall profitability, driven by rapid advancements in digital integration and high-performance components [41] . In this highly competitive environment, suppliers must ensure that their GET offerings seamlessly integrate with a variety of heavy machinery platforms. This segment's growth has been notably supported by a sustained focus on coal extraction, which represented 39 percent of industry revenue in earlier assessments [53] .
